# agentgateway_mcp_targets (Data Source)

MCP targets the gateway serves, sorted by id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every MCP target, sorted by id.
data "agentgateway_mcp_targets" "all" {}

# Only the targets whose id (the name) starts with a prefix.
data "agentgateway_mcp_targets" "team" {
  name_prefix = "team-"
}

output "target_addresses" {
  value = [
    for target in data.agentgateway_mcp_targets.all.targets : {
      name      = target.name
      transport = target.transport
      host      = target.host
      path      = target.path
    }
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name_prefix` (String) Only include targets whose id (the name) starts with this prefix.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Stable identity of the listing: `mcp.target:<name_prefix>`.
- `targets` (Attributes List) MCP targets stored by the gateway, sorted by id. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--targets))

<a id="nestedatt--targets"></a>
### Nested Schema for `targets`

Read-Only:

- `host` (String) Host of the transport. Empty for `stdio` and for `mcp`, `sse` and `openapi` transports configured with `backend`.
- `name` (String) Target name, which prefixes tool names when multiplexing.
- `path` (String) Path of the transport. Empty when the target does not set one.
- `transport` (String) Transport of the target: `mcp`, `sse`, `stdio` or `openapi`.
